<function name="ShowIcons" parent="DTree_Node" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether or not the <page>DTree</page> this node is in has icons enabled.

See <page>DTree:ShowIcons</page> for more info.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Whether the icons are shown or not</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
